title: sanguisorba ancistroides subsp. parviflora
intro: Sanguisorba ancistroides subsp. parviflora, commonly known as Dwarf Burnet, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, burns, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Sanguisorba ancistroides subsp. parviflora include astringent, antiseptic, and hemostatic effects, which help to reduce bleeding and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
